summary.headline: SAMHI Q2 FY27 same-store revenue grew 12.6% and consolidated EBITDA rose 12% to INR123.8 crores, with net debt cut to INR1,458 crores.
summary.overview: Same-store revenue grew 12.6% and same-store RevPAR about 14% (rate ~9%, occupancy ~3.6pp higher to 78.6%), ahead of the 9-11% long-term guidance. Total income rose 15.6% to INR342.7 crores, and EBITDA rose 12% to INR123.8 crores (36.1% margin), or about 21.3% growth to INR133.8 crores comparable after excluding a ~INR10 crore GST impact. PAT was INR41.1 crores, but the YoY decline reflected a high base from one-time gains in Q2 FY26. Net debt fell INR35 crores QoQ to INR1,458 crores (3.1x TTM EBITDA; 2.2x after adjusting for growth capex). Management reiterated Q3 and Q4 as the strongest quarters, supported by a dense events calendar.

financial_highlights.change: +15.6% YoY (INR45.6 crores increase; INR35.5 crores same-store, INR10.1 crores new/acquired assets)

financial_highlights.value: INR41.1 crores (INR33.5 crores attributable to SAMHI shareholders)
financial_highlights.change: YoY decline due to high Q2 FY26 base with INR84.1 crore exceptional gains; ex one-time, PAT up ~137%

financial_highlights.value: 3.1x (2.2x after adjusting for capital deployed in growth projects)
~INR3 crores after INR35 crores cash interest

segments.name: Same-store portfolio
segments.commentary: Same-store revenue +12.6%, same-store RevPAR ~+14% (ARR ~+9%, occupancy 78.6% vs 75%); 37% of nights above 90% occupancy vs 32% a year ago. Management says ~13.5% same-store growth ex a low-rated catering business that was stopped.

segments.name: Upscale and upper upscale mix
segments.commentary: Upper and upper upscale at 42% of income, targeted to rise to ~60% by FY30; upscale EBITDA ran ~800 bps ahead of the broader portfolio over the last 6 months.

segments.name: Market-level (Q2)
segments.commentary: Hyderabad total revenue +21.4% and RevPAR +19.1%; Bangalore total revenue ~+12% and RevPAR ~+8% (high base); NCR RevPAR +44% (distorted by Hyatt Place Gurgaon renovation last year); Pune RevPAR +17.2% with muted total revenue after exiting low-margin catering.

guidance_outlook: Same-store long-term guidance of 9-11% revenue growth retained; management expects same-store RevPAR ~14-15% in H2 driven by ~10-11% rate growth, and same-store total revenue ~13-14%.
From Q3 FY27 there is no comparable EBITDA reporting; reported EBITDA will converge with comparable and growth is expected in the high teens.

W Hyderabad (170 rooms, HITEC City) on track to open Q2 FY28 (project largely complete by end-FY27); stabilised on FY29 basis, ~10% of FY27 income base and up to INR170-odd crores top line per management.
Net debt/EBITDA target 2.5x long term; management expects below 3x by end-FY27 or shortly after, and 2.5x in ~18 months excluding asset recycling.
Deferred tax asset recognition of ~INR100-odd crores expected in Q4 FY27; net tax benefit for H2 FY27 estimated at INR25-30 crores.
Stand-alone RARE India: ~INR15-20 crores top line expected in FY28; RARE Outdoor Collection go-live in December 2026; RARE hotel count expected to rise from ~70 to 85-90 in 5-6 months.

Cumulative capex FY27-FY31 about INR2,250 crores net of INR150 crores GIC funding (incl. Navi Mumbai ~INR900-1,000 crores); finance cost guided at INR125-140 crores in FY28 even after two more repo hikes.
Asset recycling: two small hotels earmarked, realisation INR200-230 crores cumulative; management hopes to execute at least half in FY28.
capex_capacity: W Hyderabad (170 rooms, HITEC City): final stages, MEP/facade/fit-out in progress, opening Q2 FY28; CWIP rose to INR219 crores from INR139 crores in March.

Westin + Tribute Whitefield, Bangalore: 142-room Trinity being renovated into Tribute; 220-room Westin tower moved from excavation to basement construction in Q2; stabilisation around FY31 (Westin opening FY30 target).
Ingka Centre Noida (162 rooms): long-term variable lease, now at second-floor slab.
Sriperumbudur, Chennai: 155-room Fairfield to be a Marriott hotel with ~134 rooms added; capex ~INR160-odd crores; yield on cost ~15-17%; existing hotel at ~high-20s ROCE at INR5,500 ARR.
Navi Mumbai: ~658 rooms (Westin and Fairfield); OC issued by MIDC; capex INR900-1,000 crores; site work to start early FY28; no change to timeline yet.
demand_pricing: Occupancy 78.6% (vs 75%), near 80% for six months; 80% of room nights from domestic travellers; ~60% flow-through before loss of input tax credit.
Bangalore and Hyderabad absorbed ~7.9 million sq ft of net office absorption in the quarter vs 5.1 million a year ago; Hyderabad alone rose from 1.6 to 3.8 million sq ft.
Q1 ARR growth was sluggish (~2%) because booking windows collapsed; Q2 saw improvement in booking windows.
Management says non-event days are sold out with total revenue growth of 20-24%; affected days (holidays, long weekends) moderate the average.
Airline passenger traffic declined YoY due to route rationalisation from higher fuel prices; management says this is supply compression rather than weak demand.
Upcoming H2 events: Bangalore (Aero India, IT expos), Hyderabad (BioAsia, India Pharma Expo), Delhi NCR (Bharat Mobility, Auto Expo, Medical Fair).

qa_highlights.question: Stiperumbudur: how does the Marriott conversion change capex, RevPAR and yield versus earlier plan?
qa_highlights.answer: Adds ~134 rooms; capex ~INR160-odd crores; yield on cost ~15-17% since land is already owned; existing Fairfield hotel at high-20s ROCE at INR5,500 ARR.

qa_highlights.question: Is 20%+ RevPAR possible on MICE dates and what are rate trends?
qa_highlights.answer: Non-event days are sold out with 20-24% total revenue growth; event days could yield in high teens; same-store revenue growth of ~12.5% (13.5% ex catering exit) not at risk.

qa_highlights.question: GST: any update on ITC relief for hotels with ARR below INR7,500?
qa_highlights.answer: Council recommended ITC eligibility for same-line-of-business expenses (including OTA commissions); notification not yet issued; management expects it to come, but timing is uncertain.

qa_highlights.question: W Hyderabad: is Q4 FY28 opening at risk given approvals?
qa_highlights.answer: Project to be largely complete by end-FY27; contingencies built in for fire inspection after full enclosure and approval-delay risk, citing Hyatt Regency Pune.

qa_highlights.question: How much DTA recognition remains and what is the tax impact?
qa_highlights.answer: ~INR100-odd crores of DTA left to recognise in Q4 FY27; net H2 tax benefit INR25-30 crores after netting current deferred tax expense.

qa_highlights.question: HITEC City ADR growth and upside for W Hyderabad revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: Internal data show Holiday Inn Express HITEC City at 20-25% premium to portfolio average (~INR5,000-5,100 vs INR4,000); W could exceed INR170-odd crores top line, >10% of FY27 revenue.

qa_highlights.question: Net debt to EBITDA bridge to 2.5x?
qa_highlights.answer: Currently ~3.1x; target below 3x by end-FY27 or shortly after; net debt to stay around INR1,450-1,500 crores; 2.5x in ~18 months excluding asset recycling.

qa_highlights.question: RARE India revenue and EBITDA outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: FY28 top line ~INR15-20 crores; commission ~18% per booking; high ROCE expected as there are few employees or fixed costs; first full FY28 year of operations.

qa_highlights.question: Asset recycling and cumulative capex to FY31?
qa_highlights.answer: Two small hotels, INR200-230 crores cumulative realisation; cumulative capex ~INR2,250 crores net FY27-FY31 incl. Navi Mumbai, funded by internal accruals.

qa_highlights.question: Why keep 9-11% guidance when same-store growth is ~13%?
qa_highlights.answer: Guidance is same-store only; 3-year same-store CAGR 10.4%; new hotels (W Hyderabad, RARE, Sheraton inventory, Westin Bangalore) to add 6-7% on top from FY28-29; management aims for high-teens growth overall.

qa_highlights.question: ROCE path to 17-18% and FCF of INR3,000 crores?
qa_highlights.answer: Mature assets ~15-16% ROCE; goodwill from IPO allocation (INR238 share price) depresses ACIC ROCE; long-term target 14-15% ROCE; FCF ~INR320-350 crores this year with capex flat; FY30 revenue guidance is 9-11% same-store.

risks_watch: GST input tax credit relief for hotels with ARR below INR7,500: council recommendation exists but notification not issued; timing uncertain and management said it may come after other priorities.
W Hyderabad (170 rooms) opening in Q2 FY28: contingencies built in for fire inspection after full enclosure and approval delays; any slippage hits FY28 numbers.
Rising interest rates: management expects further repo hikes, with FY28 finance cost guided at INR125-140 crores; effective rate ~7.8% expected to rise gradually.
Deferred tax asset recognition of ~INR100-odd crores in Q4 FY27 drives a reported PAT jump; quantum and timing depend on auditor sign-off.
Net debt/EBITDA of ~3.1x must fall below 3x by end-FY27 or shortly after; 2.5x target relies on W Hyderabad EBITDA ramp and asset recycling (INR200-230 crores, counterparty timing uncertain).

Q3/Q4 same-store RevPAR ~14-15% guidance depends on events and rate growth of 10-11%; management cautioned on volatility from events beyond control and Q1 ARR was only ~2% due to collapsed booking windows.
key_quotes: Our same-store revenue grew by 12.6%. This is ahead of our long-term guidance of 9% to 11%.
We closed the quarter at near 80% occupancy, but in quarter 1, the rate was rather slugeish, 2% growth or so.
Unfortunately, the overall notification has still not been issucd. We are waiting for that to come.
So I've banked the performance, but we remain very cautious about how quarter 3 and quarter 4 will pan out.
Whatever may go wrong will go wrong. So I don't think we would like to reset optimism at this stage.
summary.management_tone: Confident on operating momentum (occupancy near 80%, same-store growth above guidance, H2 events calendar) but cautious on forward numbers: management repeatedly declined to raise the 9-11% long-term guidance, stressed volatility, and deferred on timing for Navi Mumbai, GST relief and asset recycling.

adds.what: Sriperumbudur Fairfield to Marriott, ~134 rooms added
Ingka Centre Noida 162-room hotel (long-term variable lease)

growth.why: Management guides same-store total revenue ~13-14% in H2 FY27 (rate ~10-11%, RevPAR ~14-15%), backed by 78.6% occupancy and events calendar plus W Hyderabad (170 rooms, opening Q2 FY28) and Sriperumbudur/Navi Mumbai additions, though pricing and demand drive most of the near-term number and capacity arrives mostly after FY27.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Comparable EBITDA margin ~39.1% ex ~INR10 crore GST hit, reported margin 36.1%; from Q3 FY27 reported EBITDA converges with comparable and growth guided in the high teens, with ~60% flow-through before lost input tax credit.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: W Hyderabad 170 rooms (~10% of FY27 income base) on track for Q2 FY28 with CWIP up to INR219 crore from INR139 crore; Sriperumbudur adds ~134 rooms and RARE hotel count goes from ~70 to 85-90 in 5-6 months, but Navi Mumbai (~658 rooms, INR900-1,000 crore) only starts site work early FY28 and capacity arrives mostly after FY27.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Occupancy 78.6% vs 75% a year ago, near 80% for six months, and 37% of nights above 90% occupancy vs 32%, so room volume headroom is limited but still rising with new rooms from Q2 FY28.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Capex is already committed at about INR2,250 crore net for FY27-FY31 with Navi Mumbai and Sriperumbudur in motion, and management said funding comes from internal accruals; utilisation at 78.6% is below the 80%+ threshold, so a fresh capex announcement is not the expected next step.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Same-store total revenue grew 12.6% in Q2 against the 9-11% long-term guide, H2 guided at 13-14%, and non-event days are sold out with 20-24% total revenue growth, but management has declined to raise the long-term guide.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Q3/Q4 same-store RevPAR guide of 14-15% rests on 10-11% rate growth and event timing, Q1 ARR was only ~2% on collapsed booking windows, and FY28 finance cost is guided at INR125-140 crore after more repo hikes at ~7.8% effective rate.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: W Hyderabad 170 rooms opens Q2 FY28 and RARE Outdoor Collection goes live December 2026, with RARE FY28 top line guided at INR15-20 crore.

rows.label: Net debt/EBITDA below 3x by end-FY27
rows.why: Net debt at INR1,458 crore is 3.1x TTM EBITDA, down INR35 crore QoQ, with management guiding below 3x by end-FY27 and 2.5x in about 18 months excluding asset recycling; INR200-230 crore asset recycling is only partly in the timeline.

rows.label: GST ITC relief for hotels with ARR below INR7,500
rows.why: The GST council recommended ITC eligibility, which could recover part of the ~INR10 crore quarterly GST hit, but the notification is not issued and management said it may come after other priorities.

rows.label: Deferred tax asset recognition in Q4 FY27
rows.why: About INR100-odd crore of DTA is left to recognise with net H2 FY27 tax benefit of INR25-30 crore, which will lift reported PAT, subject to auditor sign-off.

tone.note: Management was confident on occupancy near 80%, same-store growth above the 9-11% guide and the H2 events calendar, but cautious on forward numbers, declining to raise the long-term guide and deferring on GST relief, Navi Mumbai timing and asset recycling; analysts pressed on guidance versus the ~13
